topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, contextual overview, and learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cell-intrinsic alterations, including mutational clonal succession and epigenetic remodeling, confer selective fitness advantages during tumor initiation.

topics.label: Stem Cell Hierarchies and the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the relationship between normal tissue differentiation hierarchies and cancer development, assessing whether stem cells or committed progenitors serve as the cell of origin.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how extrinsic inflammatory cues and supportive stromal interactions promote tumorigenesis and sustain established malignancies.

topics.label: Experimental Technologies for Investigating Tumor Biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the sequencing, spatial transcriptomic, and proteomic methods used to analyze tumor cell heterogeneity and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of Multi-Factorial Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic brings together the combined roles of mutations, cell origin, epigenetics, and microenvironmental factors into an overarching model of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing and housekeeping remarks for the lecture.
